title: tests/db CI containers: install DB test deps from uv.lock at container start, not via Dockerfile build args
answers: Database CI job failed with 'operator does not exist: bigint > character varying' on a postgresql:// store; how are the DB test containers' dependencies installed?
How do I add a new database driver or pytest plugin to the tests/db Docker images?
Why does docker compose build no longer take a DEPENDENCIES build arg or INSTALL_MLFLOW_FROM_REPO?
Where is the mlflow DB test environment (psycopg, mysqlclient, pyodbc) set up for the compose services?
body:
Path: tests/db/compose.yml services (mlflow-postgresql, mlflow-mysql, mlflow-mssql, mlflow-sqlite and their migration-* variants) start from tests/db/Dockerfile and tests/db/Dockerfile.mssql, and every container runs tests/db/entrypoint.sh before the command, which is where the DB test environment is built.
Rule: Dockerfiles only provide the base image (python:3.11 plus uv); the environment is created at entrypoint time by `uv sync --locked --no-default-groups --extra db --group db-test` into /opt/venv, then the command runs via `uv run --no-sync "$@"` (tests/db/entrypoint.sh). The DB-only drivers (psycopg[binary], mysqlclient, pyodbc, psutil, pytest tooling) are the `db-test` dependency group in pyproject.toml, so add new test deps there and regenerate uv.lock rather than editing Dockerfiles.
Symptom: Unpinned installs in the Docker build let CI resolve SQLAlchemy 2.1, where bare postgresql:// picks psycopg v3 and string parameters are cast to ::VARCHAR, so numeric filters failed with 'operator does not exist: bigint > character varying'.
Constraints: The DEPENDENCIES build argument, extract_deps.py and INSTALL_MLFLOW_FROM_REPO no longer exist; the repo's mlflow is always the uv project. Per-container sync is intentional (a shared cache volume would not survive `compose.sh down --volumes`). Do not use the host .venv in the container; the venv is /opt/venv so bind-mounted repos are not overwritten.
applies: tests/db Docker Compose database test images and their entrypoint; not the packaged mlflow[db] extra used by end users.
says: Searching experiment runs with numeric filters fails on PostgreSQL database backends.
Filtering metrics with numerical comparisons causes database type mismatch errors.
Metric search queries fail on Postgres tracking stores due to improper type casting.
Ensure numerical search filters work reliably across all supported database tracking stores.
search: Docker Compose database test containers in tests/db build environments at entrypoint start using uv sync locked against the db-test group and db extra rather than via Dockerfile build arguments. Dockerfiles provide only the python:3.11 and uv base image, while database drivers such as psycopg[binary], mysqlclient, pyodbc, and pytest tooling are configured in pyproject.toml under db-test and synced into /opt/venv via tests/db/entrypoint.sh. This applies to compose.yml test services to prevent unpinned driver issues on stores like PostgreSQL, while DEPENDENCIES build args, extract_deps.py, and INSTALL_MLFLOW_FROM_REPO are removed.
